_comment: Recipe spells with a cooldown (F-137): the profession route never makes them a step, because a cooldown recipe cannot be repeated for skill points. Hand-kept fallback for tools/build_professions.py while the client table SpellCooldowns is not exported (tools/export_db2.ps1 lists it; once it is in ~/addons/_wago the generator takes the table and ignores this file). Picked by name and description from the client's SpellName and Spell tables and the recipe lists: every alchemy 'Transmute:' recipe (they share a daily cooldown) and Mooncloth (moonwell, days). Each spell maps to "<category>:<hours>" like ProfessionData CD (F-232): the shared cooldown category of SpellCategories (310 all transmutes, 0 none) and the cooldown in hours (taken from build 1.60.1.71037). Add a spell id here only when the game shows a cooldown on the recipe.
